title: Repair stable ranking at tied scores
goal: Implement stable_top_k(records, k) for a list of (label, score) tuples, where label is a string and score is an integer, and integer k. Return the labels of the first k records after ordering by descending score. Records with equal scores retain their original relative order. Duplicate records and duplicate labels count as separate records. If k exceeds the number of records, return all labels in this order. Empty input or k == 0 returns []. Negative k raises ValueError, including for empty input. Do not mutate records.
constraints: Only edit solution.py; do not add files or dependencies or modify tests.
Keep the public function stable_top_k(records, k) and its signature unchanged.

provenance.hidden_tests: Distinct authored inputs and bounded independent checks of the same stated specification
